cases.claim: “don’t fear the fungus” | [Visual] after applying Jublia the man returns to yoga with no sign of the 'Bigfoot foot', touching his uninfected bare feet; other participants no longer move away
cases.context: PI: Complete Cure 17.8% and 15.2% vs 3.3% and 5.5% vehicle; Mycologic Cure 55.2%/53.4% vs 16.8%/16.9%.
cases.rationale: Implies all patients achieve complete cure; 'don't fear the fungus' minimizes the condition.
cases.check: Judge: imagery of complete resolution vs. PI complete-cure rates (<20%).

cases.claim: [Visual] resolution after a single application; man returns to yoga class with foot looking normal shortly after; “don’t’ fear the fungus.” | SUPER: “Apply to affected toenails for 48 weeks. Individual results may vary.”
cases.context: Endpoints assessed at week 52; once daily for 48 weeks. SUPER appears at 15 sec, before application scenes, with little emphasis.
cases.rationale: Implies immediate results; disclaimer timing/emphasis does not mitigate.
cases.check: Judge: implied time-to-effect vs PI endpoint timing; rule: duration qualifier must appear concurrently with efficacy depiction.
